WITH film_copies AS (
  SELECT 
    f.film_id,
    f.rating,
    COALESCE(COUNT(i.inventory_id), 0) AS copy_count
  FROM film f
  LEFT JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating
),
rating_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(copy_count) AS avg_copies_for_rating
  FROM film_copies
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(copy_count) AS avg_copies_overall
  FROM film_copies
)
SELECT 
  fc.film_id,
  fc.rating,
  fc.copy_count,
  fc.copy_count - ra.avg_copies_for_rating AS diff_from_rating_avg,
  fc.copy_count - oa.avg_copies_overall AS diff_from_overall_avg
FROM film_copies fc
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
JOIN rating_avg ra ON fc.rating = ra.rating
ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
